{{Quote|First, see those critters&mdash;theysa called timas. Look at all the different types of timas!|[[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]]|<ref name="ELAC" />}}
'''Timas''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] middle-sized, two-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] critters found on the world of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="ELAC" /> a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]].<ref name="EAWGG">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> Their had [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavian]] traits and somewhat resembled the [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]], another creature also native to Naboo. There were several subspecies of Timas, with significant phenotypical differences: some specimens sported horns while others did not, some had a short, feathered tails while others had longer, lizard-like tails. Timas came in bright [[Color/Legends|shades]] of red, yellow, blue and green.<ref name="ELAC" />
